name: Himegoto*CriSISTERS
source:
Takumi Kurayami has recently started her transition! (Yipee!) But has also recently started to doubt her ability to pass as a girl...(Oh no...) Luckily for her,  her friend Koishi Miyachi and her little sister Hibiki Amamori are here to help her love herself by loving her till she explodes!

[From [url=https://shinitai-tan.itch.io/himegotocrisisters]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
仓水拓美最近开始变性了！（Yipee！）但最近也开始怀疑她作为一个女孩的能力……（哦不……）对她来说幸运的是，她的朋友Koishi Miyachi和她的妹妹Hibiki Amamori在这里帮助她爱自己，爱她直到她爆炸！

[来自[url=https://shinitai-tan.itch.io/himegotocrisisters]itch.io[/url]]
